warmup_exclusion.basis: Across all 20 seeds, samples 0-9 contain the odometry publisher's harmonic-decay initialization values; at sample 10 every trace changes discontinuously to ordinary finite vehicle velocities. The boundary was measured consistently, not selected from the resulting divergence score.

vrx_odometry_initialization_transient_se.classification: known VRX startup reporting artifact; excluded from the readable main divergence summary but retained in raw traces

kinematic.note: The pass/fail verdict remains false after warm-up exclusion; the main velocity statistics now describe samples 10-2399 rather than the known publisher artifact.

environment_response.definition: Paired environment-on minus environment-off N/E displacement for each simulator, evaluated independently per seed at each preregistered checkpoint.
